chapters.title: The Shutter Keeps the Shadows Still

description:
A Very Unusual Town | Surreal AI Film • AI Music Video (4K)

On a solo travel trip, I wandered off the main road and found a tiny hillside town that felt… unreal. Quiet streets, handmade faces, and a few elderly locals who looked like they’d been there forever. That moment stayed with me — and became the spark for this film, made to honor the beauty, mystery, and strength of old souls.

I wrote the story first, I turned my ideas into images using #Midjourney and Nano Banana Pro, brought them to life with VEO 3, and composed three original songs with @Suno. The entire idea and creative direction are mine — AI simply helped me complete what I saw in my head. It’s also expensive work, and I spent about 48 hours straight making this piece.

If it moved you, please share what you felt in the comments. ❤️
And thank you to everyone who became a channel member, sent Super Thanks, or bought my music — you’re the reason I can keep creating in a world where AI tools cost so much. Thank you to every viewer who watches, likes, and comments. I love you all.

🎵 Tracks on Bandcamp (Surreal AI):
